text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes all 16 tests. I didn't touch the tests. The fixes in `catalog/` were:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` had an off-by-one slice (`[-n - 1:]`) and returned `n + 1` events. It now returns exactly `n`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 even though the comment and tests say five. It is now 5.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing "Emma", so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count for Emma aren't in the tests, so I chose them. Only the title is checked.
